purpose: Executable stage-entry/feedback contract. Prevents work from jumping ahead, conflating requirements with derived loads, losing datum/measurement/configuration semantics, or silently correcting upstream design from downstream findings.

stages.exit: requirement/interface envelope explicit with acceptance or explicit OPEN state
responsibility allocated to controlled system/subsystem/interface/part/characteristic targets; share/budget or complementary responsibility explicit
selected concept/alternative rationale, technical-filter disposition and affected interface architecture recorded
derived loads/limits/screening inputs have stable IDs, quantity kind, derivation/source chain, status and consumers; requirements/assumptions remain distinguishable
route alternatives, supplier/process capability needs, inspectability and route-selection status explicit; process-dependent release semantics blocked while route OPEN

stable characteristic IDs define nominal/requirement, variation semantics, datum/reference system, measurement condition, material/surface/process, inspection strategy, configuration/effectivity and CONTROLLED/PARTIAL/OPEN state
deterministic CAD binding + native PMI/annotation semantic readback + required binding-invariance level PASS or explicit HOLD
strength/thermal/magnetic/flow/contact/etc behavior evidence verified against explicit cases and source fingerprints
tolerance stacks, variation, process capability and inspectability evidence verify assigned variation semantics or return feedback

stages.entry: authoritative characteristic context and applicable S3/S4 evidence states available
stages.exit: compiled Product Definition plus domain-specific fingerprints/slices generated; release blockers explicit
SLDDRW projects only compiled controlled semantics/OPEN states; semantic QA PASS; visual QA separately recorded
released inspection plan/procedure plus actual inspection/test results are configuration-bound; failures generate feedback/NCR/EFR

stages.entry: all release blockers closed; required S3/S4/S5/S6 verification PASS

feedback_loops.trigger: definition conflict or impossible characteristic architecture
binding cannot be made deterministic/invariant without changing design intent
ambiguity or missing semantic definition detected
feedback_loops.mechanism: EFR; drawing itself may not invent fix

feedback_loops.trigger: inspection impossible/noncapable or test failure reveals design/process issue

hard_rules: No requirement-to-characteristic trace without an allocation object when responsibility is part/interface-specific.
No derived load/value may masquerade as a requirement or characteristic; quantity identity and derivation are mandatory.
No S5 implementation may read raw legacy candidate_spec text as drawing authority.
No stage may silently convert OPEN into a numeric value.
No downstream finding may directly mutate an upstream characteristic; use EFR/change control and rerun impact.
Datum/reference system and measurement condition are Product Definition semantics, not drawing cosmetics.
PMI existence/save-reopen is not binding-invariance PASS; required L2/L3 qualification is separate.
Physics and variation/capability evidence are separate and become stale from different change domains.
Inspection strategy is defined with the characteristic in S2; S6 owns procedures/results, not late discovery of basic inspectability.
Manufacturing route/supplier capability must be controlled before release of process-dependent tolerances/roughness/joining notes.
Every released artifact/characteristic has configuration/effectivity; released history is immutable.
Every Class A/B change runs graph-based pre-change impact and shared-interface counterpart review before write.
Automatic stale propagation is allowed; automatic counterpart engineering mutation is prohibited.
Drawing authoring is claim-level; a single Cxx may target multiple annotation/drawing views.
Annotation-view role is Product Definition context. Concrete SOLIDWORKS annotation-view identity/orientation is D2/D3 evidence.
Release-native D5 uses only a capability-qualified DimXpert/PMI transport. K01 does not treat InsertModelAnnotations3 as proven DimXpert transport after prior zero-annotation evidence.
D6 is visual/layout-only and must prove semantic fingerprint invariance before/after human layout.
D7 verifies tolerance/GD&T provenance by characteristic/claim/model-carrier identity, not by comparing sets of numeric values.
General tolerance and default surface finish are conditional controlled policies; absence never authorizes template defaults.
DXF and STEP AP242 PMI are conditional D9 deliverables based on controlled delivery profile/capability, not universal outputs.
Drawing-family classification and view routing are presentation logic only; they may not create or modify Product Characteristics.
For reusable part families, D1 must consume the controlled drawing-family plan before claim-level authoring so view selection/routing is not rediscovered manually on every part.
D2 authoring order is Datum/DRF -> Size/Fit -> Location/Pattern -> GD&T -> Surface -> Material/Process unless a controlled exception is recorded.

Every active engineering discipline is registered in control/system/K01_ENGINEERING_DOMAIN_REGISTRY_CURRENT.json. A missing discipline/evidence family is an explicit OPEN gap with action, never silent omission. Whole-system coverage PASS is not release PASS.

D3 exemplar verification is layered: L1 save/reopen and L2 no-op rebuild may close the first exemplar assurance step; L3 perturb/restore requires an explicitly controlled benign parameter/delta and remains a release blocker until qualified.

D7 first-exemplar QA may pass a bounded authorized claim scope while release D7 remains HOLD. Exemplar PASS may not be promoted to manufacturing release by omission of configuration/effectivity, D6 fingerprint, D8 or open Product Definition claims.

A D7 finding is corrected on the same controlled exemplar when it is presentation-only. Any correction requiring nominal/tolerance/GD&T/datum/material/process semantics returns upstream through EFR/change control.

drawing_pipeline.release_rule: D9/release lane requires D3/D4/D7/D8 evidence. V10 design-review fallback projection cannot satisfy release-native D7 coverage.
drawing_pipeline.feedback: Any D3/D7/D8 semantic/inspectability/manufacturability issue that requires Product Definition change generates EFR and returns upstream; D6 cannot mutate semantics.
drawing_pipeline.family_rule: D1 consumes V13 family plan; family logic selects representation/routing only, Product Definition remains semantic authority.

v15_assurance.sequence: existing V12 exemplar -> D3 L1/L2 -> D7 first-exemplar semantic QA -> correct listed presentation defects on same SLDDRW -> D8 visual QA -> freeze first exemplar
v15_assurance.prohibition: No new drawing generator or manual release dimensions while this sequence is active.

drawing_exemplar_rule.release_boundary: Exemplar PASS never overrides Product Definition, D3, D7, D8 or manufacturing-route HOLD.
drawing_exemplar_rule.learning_loop: Exemplar actual SW2018 annotation-view/import/layout evidence is the specification for future D5 automation.

parallel_release_lanes.definition_spine: requirements -> allocation -> decision/derived inputs -> Product Characteristics -> CAD/MBD -> compiled Product Definition
